fullContentHtml:
UPSC CDS Result 2026 Out: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has announced the result of the written exam conducted for the Combined Defence Services (CDS). This CDS Result is for the exam that was held on 12th April 2026. Candidates who have qualified in the exam will be called to appear for the SSB interview. The score cards and cut-off will be available after the declaration of the final result. The result is a big step towards becoming an officer in the Indian Army, Navy or Air Force. If the roll number is on the list, candidates have successfully cleared the 1st big hurdle of the recruitment process.

CDS 1 Result 2026 Out

The commission released the list specifically for the candidates who sat for the written exam on April 12. If candidates find the roll number in the official PDF, it means they have qualified for the SSB interview stage. The results were processed quickly within 18 days of the exam so that students have enough time to prepare for the physical & mental tests that come next.

Thousands of students from all over India appeared for the exam, making it a very tough competition. The release of the CDS 1 result confirms which students have the basic knowledge needed for the military academies. Candidates should keep the admit card close by so they can easily find their roll number in the long list. Remember, the result only shows who passed the written part; the final job offer comes only after the interview and medical checkup.

CDS Results 2026: Overview

Understanding the basic details of the exam is important for every student. The table below gives you a quick summary of the CDS Result and what the recruitment process looks like for the year 2026.

Feature Details
Exam Name CDS 1 2026
Who Conducts It? Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Exam Date April 12, 2026
Result Status Released
Total Vacancies 451
Next Stage SSB Interview (5-Day Process)
Official Website upsc.gov.in

CDS Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The CDS result 2026 PDF download link is now live and can be found on the ‘What’s New’ section of the UPSC homepage. You don’t need a password or a login ID to see this list because it is a public file for everyone. The PDF contains separate lists for the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers Training Academy (OTA).

By clicking the official CDS 2026 Result link, you can save the file to your phone or computer. Once you open it, you can quickly see if you made the cut. It is a good idea to keep a digital copy of the result in case one needs it later for the interview registration. If the website loads slowly, it means many students are trying to check the CDS 1 result at the same time, so just refresh the page.

CDS 1 Result 2026 PDF: Click Here to Download

What Are The Steps to Check CDS 2026 Result?

Checking the CDS Result is simple & takes only a few minutes. Candidates need to follow the official UPSC website to find the right document. Make sure candidates have a proper internet connection so the PDF loads quickly. Here are the steps given under to find the CDS 1 result:

  1. Go to the Site: Visit the official UPSC website at upsc.gov.in.
  2. Find the Link: Look at the section of “What’s New” on the right side of the page
  3. Select Result: Click on “Written Result: Combined Defence Services Examination (I), 2026.”
  4. Open the File: A PDF will open up showing rows of roll numbers
  5. Search for You: Use the “Search” or “Find” tool (Ctrl+F) & type in the roll number.
  6. Check Success: If the number appears candidates have passed the result!
  7. Save It: Download and print the page for your own records.

Details Mentioned on the CDS 1 Results PDF

The CDS result 2026 PDF is a formal document that lists everyone who passed the written test. It is not just a random list but it is divided into categories based on which military branch candidates applied for. Candidates should read the whole document because it contains dates & instructions for the next steps. Here is what the candidates will find inside the CDS 2026 Result file:

  • Roll Numbers: The list of ID numbers of students who passed
  • Academy Names: Clear headings for IMA, INA, AFA & OTA.
  • Registration Rules: Instructions on how to sign up for the SSB interview on the “Join Indian Army” portal.
  • Document List: A list of certificates (like birth proof and degree) you need to keep ready.
  • Official Notice: Details about the date of the written exam.

What Are The CDS 1 Qualifying Marks?

To pass the CDS 1 Result candidates must score at least the minimum “qualifying marks” set by the UPSC. Candidates must pass every subject individually (usually 20%) & also reach a total score for the academy one wants to join. If candidates fail to get the minimum marks in even one subject the roll number won’t appear in the CDS Result.

Academy Estimated Passing Marks (Total) Passing % per Subject
IMA (Army) 125 – 135 20%
INA (Navy) 118 – 128 20%
AFA (Air Force) 145 – 155 20%
OTA (Short Service) 100 – 110 20%

CDS 2026 Score Card

The CDS 1 score card is your personal report card that shows exactly how many marks you got in each subject. UPSC usually releases this score card about two or three weeks after the final results (after SSB) are finished. While the CDS Result only tells the candidates if one has passed or failed right now the score card shows the actual performance in English, Math & General Knowledge.

To see your CDS 1 score card, you will need to log in with your roll number and birth date on the UPSC “Marks Information” page. This is very helpful because it shows you which subjects you are good at and where you need more practice. Even if you didn’t pass this time, looking at your CDS 1 score card will help you study better for the next exam.

What Next After CDS Result 2026?

If candidates have passed the CDS Result the next big step is the SSB Interview. This is a 5-day stay at a military center where officers will test your personality and teamwork. Before you go, you must register on the “Join Indian Army” website within two weeks of the result. Passing the written result is a great achievement, but you must stay focused for the interview.

  1. Register Online: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in to sign up and select your SSB dates
  2. Get Fit: Start running & exercising daily to be physically ready for the GTO tasks
  3. Read News: Stay updated with current affairs for the personal interview & group discussions.
  4. Check Papers: Make sure the school & college certificates are original and correct.
  5. Wait for Call: You will receive an email and SMS with your interview location and date.

CDS Result FAQs

1. When was the CDS 1 2026 exam held and when was the result declared?

The exam was held on April 12, 2026, and the CDS Result was officially declared by UPSC

2. Where can I find my cds 1 score card?

You can find your cds 1 score card on the UPSC website under the “Marks Information” tab once it is released (usually after the entire selection process).

3. What if my roll number is not in the CDS Result?

If your number is not there, it means you didn’t hit the cut-off marks this time. You can check your marks via the cds 1 score card later to see where you missed out.

4. Is it mandatory to register on the Army website after the CDS Result?

Yes, all candidates who pass the written CDS Result must register on the Join Indian Army website to be eligible for the SSB Interview.

5. How many marks do I need to clear the CDS Result?

You generally need around 20% in each subject and an overall score between 100-155 depending on the academy you choose.
